policies.name: Authenticated users can insert own entries
policies.with_check:
((tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (resident_id IN ( SELECT profiles.id
   FROM profiles
  WHERE (profiles.user_id = auth.uid()))))

policies.name: Resident reads own entries
policies.qual:
((tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (resident_id IN ( SELECT profiles.id
   FROM profiles
  WHERE (profiles.user_id = auth.uid()))))

policies.name: Supervisor+ reads all tenant entries
policies.qual: ((tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (get_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['supervisor'::text, 'director'::text, 'institution_admin'::text, 'admin'::text])))

policies.name: no_inserts_for_lapsed_tenants
policies.with_check:
CASE
    WHEN (get_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['supervisor'::text, 'director'::text, 'institution_admin'::text, 'admin'::text])) THEN true
    ELSE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
       FROM subscriptions
      WHERE ((subscriptions.tenant_id = case_entries.tenant_id) AND (subscriptions.status = ANY (ARRAY['past_due'::text, 'unpaid'::text]))))))
END

policies.name: residents soft delete own entries
policies.qual:
((resident_id = ( SELECT profiles.id
   FROM profiles
  WHERE (profiles.user_id = auth.uid()))) AND (tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
policies.with_check:
((resident_id = ( SELECT profiles.id
   FROM profiles
  WHERE (profiles.user_id = auth.uid()))) AND (tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (deleted_at IS NOT NULL))

policies.name: residents update own draft or rejected entries
policies.qual:
((resident_id = ( SELECT profiles.id
   FROM profiles
  WHERE (profiles.user_id = auth.uid()))) AND (tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'rejected'::text])) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
policies.with_check:
((resident_id = ( SELECT profiles.id
   FROM profiles
  WHERE (profiles.user_id = auth.uid()))) AND (tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND ((status = 'draft'::text) OR (status = 'pending'::text)))

policies.qual: ((tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (get_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['supervisor'::text, 'director'::text, 'institution_admin'::text, 'admin'::text])) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
policies.with_check: ((tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (get_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['supervisor'::text, 'director'::text, 'institution_admin'::text, 'admin'::text])) AND (deleted_at IS NOT NULL))

policies.name: supervisor+ update pending tenant entries
policies.qual: ((tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (get_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['supervisor'::text, 'director'::text, 'institution_admin'::text, 'admin'::text])) AND (status = 'pending'::text) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
policies.with_check: ((tenant_id = get_tenant_id()) AND (get_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['supervisor'::text, 'director'::text, 'institution_admin'::text, 'admin'::text])) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'rejected'::text])))
